page.heading: What the agent knows
page.intro: Knowledge base items come from the form, in the {link} tab. You can also add texts (with an image) here.
page.mediaTakenOver: To train with websites and videos, go back to the form in advanced mode there.
page.mediaTurnOn: To train with websites and videos, turn on advanced mode there.
page.mediaAdvanced: In advanced mode, websites and videos are added here.
page.emptyDescription: Fill in the knowledge base in the form on the Function tab and publish, or add a text here.
page.actionError: Could not complete the action. Try again.

add.title: Add training
add.description: The agent learns from the content and starts using it in its answers.

TEXT.label: Text
TEXT.hint: A text, with an image if you want

add.videoHint: E.g., a YouTube video explaining the product.
add.subPagesHint: The agent learns from the website pages starting at this address.
add.refreshHint: For websites that change often, such as catalogs and prices.
add.error: Could not send the training. Try again.

edit.title: Edit text
edit.description: The agent starts using the new text and image in its answers.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Review them and try again.
errors.AGENT_OUT_OF_SYNC: The agent was not found in GPTMaker; contact support.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_EDITABLE: Only text trainings can be edited; remove this one and create another.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_READY: The training is still being registered in GPTMaker; try again shortly.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_FAILED: Only failed trainings can be resent.
errors.TRAINING_NOT_RETRYABLE: This document's file is not stored here; remove it and upload the document again.
errors.TRAINING_BUSY: Another training for this agent is being sent; try again shortly.
errors.TRAINING_MANAGED_BY_FUNCTION: This training comes from the agent's function form; change the item there.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND: Image not found; upload the image again.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image exceeds the maximum allowed size.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_INVALID_TYPE: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are accepted.
errors.TRAINING_IMAGE_IN_USE: This image is already used in another training; upload the image again.
errors.PLAN_TRAINING_LIMIT: You have reached your plan's training limit. Remove some or change plans.
errors.GPTMAKER_REJECTED: GPTMaker rejected the training. Review the content and try again.
errors.GPTMAKER_UNAVAILABLE: Could not send the training to GPTMaker right now. Try again shortly.
